testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-user-association.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-23094 sales rep removed from a store is not offered for that store's users

scenario.summary: The admin replaces store A with store B in a sales rep's stores and saves; on a store A user's Manage User the Sales Rep popup no longer lists that sales rep.
steps: Open the sales rep's (@rep.userId) Manage page; remove store A (@storeA.name) and select store B (@storeB.name), since Stores is required; Save and Close.
Accounts & Users > Users; open the store A user (@user.userName) with Manage.
Click the search icon next to Sales Rep.
stateChanges: The sales rep's store A assignment is removed (both deleted at teardown).
assertions: The sales rep removed from store A is not in the popup for store A
evidence: Story Z10-28590 (Stabilize Sales Rep Workflow), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-28590/analysis.md section 9 (group B remainder) and answers in sections 6 and 9.3.
FSD 'Store Assignment Rules for Sales Rep': store changes are reflected immediately in the popup.
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store the migrated suites run on (store A). Store B: STORE_WEBSTORE_ACTIVE with exceptPortalId = @storeA.portalId (any other active webstore).
Admin session: the suite's saved admin session (admin.setup.ts), a credential, not a need.

Deviation (user decision 2026-11-25): the case leaves Stores empty, but atstage 10.14.7.0 refuses that save ('Please select at least one Store.', no request sent; run tda-playwright-1795603752492), so the test replaces store A with store B (STORE_WEBSTORE_ACTIVE exceptPortalId = @storeA.portalId), as 23084.
